description: A NEGATIVE fixture, and it is schema-invalid on purpose: 'edit' declares no 'is'. The loader has no opinion on it - FormKind.Unknown is C#'s zero - and the screen it builds throws instead, which is the one thing here that is being pinned: a stage past the declaration failing, and the stage after it left unknown. The editor flags this file; the schema is exactly the beam this file says the loader does not have.
